findings.text: the first line names no revision, tree or command, and the log's own mtime precedes the commit it is meant to pin, so the recorded 19-pass result is not attributable to the reviewed head from the record, while the negative-control.log written by the same run does carry the declared string on its first line.

`_review_dispatch_argv(record)` receives no configuration, so it composes `--backend <owning>` for a run whose owning backend the flight configuration lists in `review_excluded_backends`, and the next_action printed at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2700 therefore names a lane the same change's schema text says is removed from every composed review lane, while the reflex at :566 refuses or steps away, leaving two surfaces of one key disagreeing.

item_verdicts.diff: read as one commit, 5b98a1c2 on 75b39d4d; it adds the `review_excluded_backends` slot to reckon/schema/flight.yaml and regenerates reckon/_flight_schema.py and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, rewrites `_review_lane_candidates` to order owning-then-local-then-alphabetical over exclusion-filtered names, adds `_no_review_lane_reason` and `_sweeping_session`, carries the owning lane into the printed command at reckon/crew/recovery.py:218-231, and filters `dispatch_awaiting_reviews` to the sweeping session at :712-716.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names five behaviours in tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py plus a declared negative control; the fixture's owning lane clive deliberately differs from the locally served lane alpha, the tests at :171, :197, :227, :254 and :283 assert owning-lane selection, exclusion-honouring fallback, refusal naming the exclusion, session bookending and the copyable command, and the module's six tests plus the two neighbour modules' thirteen are the nineteen gate-head.log records against the thirteen gate-base.log records.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the review sweep compose each review's lane from the owning run's recorded backend and never fall back onto a backend the flight configuration excludes from review routing; at the reviewed head reckon/crew/recovery.py:395-411 drops every name in `review_excluded_backends` from `_review_lane_candidates` before any ordering and promotes the owning backend ahead of the locally served lane, and reckon/crew/recovery.py:566-576 reaches that ordering on the reflex path and refuses through `_no_review_lane_reason` at :446-462 when no candidate remains.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; it is status complete with an empty blockers line, names base 75b39d4d and the single commit 5b98a1c2, the gate and base logs, the bare negative-control path, records 19 passed as 6 new plus 13 neighbour tests against 13 at base, and its checkpoint leaves the review and the driving followup to the coordinator.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared set is exactly the diff, `git diff --numstat 75b39d4d..5b98a1c2` being 20/0 docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, 54/1 docs/evidence/archive/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking-landed.html, the binary docs/figures/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/review-lane-composition.png, 71/0 its script, 9/0 docs/plans/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking.html, 1/0 reckon/_flight_schema.py, 109/16 reckon/crew/recovery.py, 11/0 reckon/schema/flight.yaml and 346/0 tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py, and nothing outside it.

justifications.durability: the exclusion guard is falsified by its own declared control, whose red log records both exclusion tests failing when the alphabetical fallback is reinstated because the fixture's excluded lane alpha is the locally served one, and the owning-lane, session-filter and printed-command tests in tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py each redden on their own revert, the sweep test carrying its own positive control in r-mine.
justifications.evidence: the gate ran exactly the modules the done_when names and both results are recorded in gate-head.log and gate-base.log, but neither log's first line names the revision, tree or command the node's own manifest template requires though negative-control.log did honour that form, and their 08:56 mtimes precede the 09:15 commit, so the record alone cannot attribute the 19-pass run to the reviewed head; the 19 passed my own re-run at 5b98a1c2 (log at runs/r-20260923T072310177614-review-of-the-review-lane-follows-the-owning-run/logs/recheck_gate.log), which is an external receipt rather than the node's own record.
justifications.fit: the new helpers `_review_excluded_backends`, `_no_review_lane_reason` and `_sweeping_session` are named by the mechanism each performs, the exclusion text is worded identically across reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, and no plan, sprint or ticket label appears in any changed name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:566-614 composes onto the exclusion-filtered list's first candidate and dispatches with `backend_override=backend` off the local lane, so the reflex lands on the owning lane and can never land on an excluded one; the one gap is the copyable command named in the second finding.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --numstat 75b39d4d..5b98a1c2` is the declared paths and nothing else, both HTML edits are additive except the plan-verifies meta line extending plan-verifies with #s4, plan-version and plan-modified are untouched, and no test is skipped, disabled or relaxed.
